name: mivlet
description: Mivlet is a local-first AI agent workspace.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mivlet/protocol build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/connectors build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/agent-host build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/broker build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/hosted-runner build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/desktop build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/accounts build
scripts.verify:build: pnpm --filter @mivlet/protocol check:spine-parity && pnpm --filter @mivlet/connectors build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/agent-host typecheck && pnpm --filter @mivlet/agent-host build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/broker build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/hosted-runner build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/desktop build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/accounts build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mivlet/protocol check:spine-parity && pnpm --filter @mivlet/connectors build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/agent-host typecheck && pnpm --filter @mivlet/broker typecheck && pnpm --filter @mivlet/hosted-runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @mivlet/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @mivlet/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @mivlet/accounts typecheck
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm dead-code && pnpm cycles
scripts.perf:runtime: pnpm --filter @mivlet/connectors exec vitest run src/performance-baseline.test.ts && pnpm --filter @mivlet/knowledge exec vitest run src/performance-baseline.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml perf_
scripts.check:pr: pnpm typecheck && pnpm quality && pnpm test:pr
scripts.check: pnpm quality && pnpm verify:build && pnpm test && pnpm perf:check && pnpm perf:test && pnpm perf:runtime && pnpm release:test && pnpm tauri:check && pnpm audit:all
